newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Eng Kong to buy container company PCL.
newsitem.headline: Eng Kong to buy container company PCL.

text.p: Shipping container logistics firm Eng Kong Holdings said on Friday it intends to purchase used container company PCL (Pte) Ltd.
It said in a statement it would buy all the issued share capital of PCL, but did not disclose further details.
PCL's customers include members of the Eng Kong group which purchase used containers for sale to their own customers.

PCL was not bought into the group prior to the listing of Eng Kong in March because there were some uncertainties over the effect its inclusion would have on both companies' business, the statement said.
A circular explaining the terms for the purchase of PCL and the rationale for the acquisition would be sent to shareholders later, it said.
